items.prompt: When a situation in real life adds or takes some amount away from another, we can describe using mathematical symbols. For example: a jug holds five eighths 5/8 litre. Maya pours in two eighths 2/8 litre.
items.demo: Five eighths in the jug 5/8, and two eighths poured in 2/8, so I write five eighths plus two eighths. *5/8 + 2/8*

items.prompt: Now, a jug holds five eighths 5/8 litre. Maya pours out two eighths 2/8 litre.
items.demo: Five eighths in the jug 5/8, and two eighths poured out 2/8, so I write five eighths minus two eighths. *5/8-2/8*

items.prompt: Next. A jug holds five eighths 5/10 litre. Maya pours out three eighths 3/10 litre.
items.demo: I can model the situation like this: *5/10-3/10*

items.prompt: Finally, a jug holds five eighths 5/10 litre. Maya pours in three eighths 3/10 litre.
items.demo: I can model the situation like this: *5/10 + 3/10*
